@format: Formatting templates — keep every {placeholder} exactly, but reorder them and the literal text to the natural order of the language. dateTime: a full date ({year}, {month} as a number, {monthName}, {day}). monthYear: the header above a calendar month grid. clockWithPeriod: where the AM/PM word ({period}) sits relative to the clock digits ({time}). duration*: compact elapsed-time units, e.g. "3d" / "3일". Digits stay Latin (0-9).
